prompt: A linear function $g$ satisfies $g(1) = 8$ and $g(3) = 14$. What is the value of $g(7)$?
hint: Find the constant rate of change first.

hints.text: Find the constant rate of change first.
From $x = 1$ to $x = 3$ the output rose $6$ over a run of $2$, so the slope is $3$.

learningObjective: Extend a linear pattern using a constant rate of change.
explanation: Slope $= \dfrac{14 - 8}{3 - 1} = \dfrac{6}{2} = 3$: every increase of $1$ in $x$ raises $g$ by $3$.
From $x = 3$ to $x = 7$ is an increase of $4$, so $g$ rises by $3 \times 4 = 12$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Build the whole equation
steps: Building the equation costs one extra step but pays off if the question asks for several values.
